subject: P004 TECAPEEK PVX production material evidence boundary
decision: Retain Ensinger TECAPEEK PVX black as P004 design material
Use manufacturer CLTE 30e-6/K as direct evidence from 23 C upward; below 23 C remains extrapolated screen unless qualified cold data is obtained
Manufacturer evidence supports bearing/sliding use, machining, low moisture absorption and 55 C service
Supplier lot/stock/CoC and dimensional conditioning remain production-release evidence
Do not claim -40 C production tolerance verification from current manufacturer CLTE data alone
